_comment: REVERTED (2026-08-12): primary switched back from azure_gpt5_mini to claude_sonnet now that a real Claude AI Foundry deployment exists for this subscription -- the 2026-08-11 stopgap is over. Claude Sonnet 4.6 (claude_sonnet_client.py) is the permanent primary extraction engine -- single whole-document call (no page splitting), validated across all 4 sample vendor statements (69-602 rows), column-agnostic mapping that correctly disambiguates vendors with multiple invoice-number-like columns, and (as of the vendor_name/statement_date prompt fix) reliable document-level vendor_name extraction. Supersedes both azure_doc_intel and Gemini as primary (see RULES.md RULE-04 for the fuller provider history). Deterministic pdfplumber (with internal OCR fallback for scanned pages) remains the non-AI last resort, unchanged. Gemini and Mistral are kept registered in provider_config_paths as alternate/fallback options -- accessible directly via get_ai_client() -- but are not part of the active chain. claude/azure_gpt5_*/azure_doc_intel config paths remain registered for the same reason.
